negativeScope.target: Source-attributed relation in the original whole abstract, not universal scientific truth or exhaustive full-text knowledge.
negativeScope.USED_FOR: Retain downstream_application, component_operation, training_proxy and background_method_use only with a predicate and actor attribution. Do not inherit whole-model relations into every component.
negativeScope.EVALUATED_ON: Require evaluation evidence attributed to this method on this dataset; training use does not imply evaluation.
negativeScope.NO_RELATION: Require explicit source-local negation or an exclusion/exclusive contrast that rules out the corresponding positive relation under the SAME broad scope. Different direct actors, no predicate, co-occurrence, poor scores, or training use alone are insufficient.
negativeScope.UNRESOLVED: Insufficient or ambiguous evidence, including a role contrast that does not exclude indirect use; mask from ordinary classification training.
negativeScope.NOT_EXPRESSED: Diagnostic lack of expression, not an ordinary negative class.
negativeScope.reviewOfFiveOldNegatives: Withdraw all five to UNRESOLVED. Preserve previous labels, spans, reasons and support; no new negatives are manufactured.

evaluation.input: Original whole abstract only; no title, URL, taskRole or reference coreference evidence injected into model features.
evaluation.grain: Publication group; aliases, mention pairs, text windows and arXiv versions of the same paper stay in one partition.
evaluation.exposedPilot: All twelve reviewed papers remain train-only. Historical corpus, abstract queue identities and supplemental development papers are excluded from new validation/test.
evaluation.futureSelection: Lock a metadata-only inventory and selection seed BEFORE collecting/reviewing evaluation text or viewing predictions. Random representative validation/test and purposive rare-class challenge are separate cohorts; no challenge oversampling in headline metrics.
evaluation.representativeSampling: Uniform sample without replacement at publication-group level from an explicitly declared fresh-paper population; record population hash, seed, planned sizes and inclusion probabilities before drawing.
evaluation.testPolicy: New final test remains sealed through model/config selection. One final evaluation of the frozen candidate; if test-informed changes occur, results become development evidence and a new final holdout is required.
evaluation.partialLabels: UNRESOLVED and NOT_EXPRESSED are never NO_RELATION. Partial-label conditional scores must not be presented as complete end-to-end Precision; full-pipeline evaluation requires complete relation adjudication or an explicit unscored/uncertain denominator.
metrics: strict directed span/type/label end-to-end RE Precision/Recall/F1
per-class and per-taskRole support, source papers and coverage
mention-level and distinct support-group-level descriptive results
evaluation.supportGroupMetric: Count a group hit once if any correct predicted triple matches its reference group. Report incorrect prediction counts separately; do not collapse unrelated false positives into guessed semantic groups or advertise group hit rate as independent fact accuracy.
evaluation.trainingRepetition: Within each training paper/supportGroup use one deterministically chosen mention pair per epoch, rotating aliases by a predeclared seed; apply only after a separately authorized training snapshot. No resampling is executed in this batch.
evaluation.selection: Keep SciBERT/schema fixed for a future bounded data-quality comparison, select checkpoints on new fixed validation only. Predeclared practical candidate gate: end-to-end validation F1 improvement at least 0.02, no deterioration of class-level TP or negative FP under the same supported comparison. Rare classes with fewer than 10 distinct reference papers remain insufficient for reliable class-level generalization claims. Validation improvement is not a test score or statistical significance.
evaluation.authorization: A frozen protocol alone never authorizes training: reviewed negative support, frozen train/validation identities, complete evaluation coverage and a separate explicit training contract are still required. No automatic promotion.
